propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single-scalar environment variable that must be deprecated in favor of per-class model configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_COMPLETER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_GATE_MODEL) to eliminate ambiguity and support per-tier mapping.

The deprecation must be registered with _scheduled(...) in _deprecations.REGISTRY with a migration window (permanent=False, remove_in=_MAJOR at v1.0.0), not _permanent, because it is a supersession by a different interface rather than a rename of an established name.

Deprecation warnings must be emitted at two distinct environment-read sites: config.py:469 (from_env read path) and model_classes.py (fan-out read path), with the warning checked at each site to ensure both code paths that resolve the variable are covered.

When REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no per-class models are configured, the bare variable must map to all three classes with full precedence: CLI > per-class env > config table > REBAR_LLM_MODEL > built-in default.

Operator-visible documentation and help text in _cli/_llm_commands.py, _mcp_llm.py, llm/config.py, and six prose files (README.md, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/config.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md, docs/env-vars.md) must be updated to present the per-class configuration as current and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated.

Example configurations for Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, and local+fallback scenarios must be added to docs/ as complete [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] TOML tables that operators can paste directly.
